args.body: Use capture-scope-screen.json if committed, or reuse your equivalent full-capture screen. Inspect the original text for the most plausible live asset-register candidate within your existing single-notice allowance. Treat keyword matches and structured dates as pointers. If the original terms support an independently quotable offline deliverable, run the passing and failing fictional controls against one quoted requirement and prepare the private French quote. Otherwise preserve the decisive clause or bounded coverage gap and the original buyer evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed outcome and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep draft, submission, acceptance and settlement separate.
